title: Generalized Graph Compositions with Applications to Difference Graphs of Finite Groups
summary: The difference graph $D(G)$ of a finite group $G$ is obtained from the edge difference between its intersection power graph and power graph, after deleting isolated vertices. This graph has already been studied, with sufficient conditions for connectedness and a diameter bound $6$ for finite groups satisfying those conditions. We use generalized graph composition to reduce $D(G)$ to a graph $B(G)$ on the cyclic subgroups of $G$, so that connectedness and diameter are determined by the subgroup structure of $G$.
